name: fiori-shepherd-guide
description: SAP Fiori Launchpad plugin that shows guided tours (powered by ShepherdJS) inside Fiori apps.

scripts.build: npm run build:shepherd && ui5 build --clean-dest && node scripts/ascii-dist.mjs
